subject: Re: Coordination - APAC pilot demo timing (timezone mismatch)
messages:
From: Ellie Park <ellie.park@umbratek.io>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@novatel-health.com>, Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@hana-health.jp>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot demo — proposed slot (Jun 7)

Hi Chloe / Marcus —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. Our global pilot team has availability the week of June 7th and we'd like to lock a time that works for all three regions. Proposed slot: 

  - Monday, 7 June — 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 18:00 CEST / 01:00 JST (next day)

That time keeps it within business hours for EU and the US, but I realize it's late for APAC. If we need to be APAC-friendly, we can do an alternate on Tues 8 June local-morning for Tokyo.

A couple of notes: the calendar invite I saw shows the event as 16:00 UTC which displayed differently in my calendar and caused some confusion with the Japan attendees — could we confirm the invite timezone and whether the organizer used UTC vs local zones?

Agenda looks light (30–40m): pilot runbook, data flow, SLAs. If helpful, I can attach the pilot checklist.

Cheers,
Ellie
Director, Partnerships — Umbratek

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Park <ellie.park@umbratek.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@hana-health.jp>, Samir Rao <samir@novatel-health.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — proposed slot (Jun 7)

Thanks Ellie — and great to see momentum.

Quick heads-up: Marcus will be traveling on June 7th (international flight) and the invite appears to have been created in UTC which is why Keiko saw it as 01:00 JST the next day. We usually pin invites using the organizer's timezone to avoid those DST/UTC translation issues.

Options that would keep us high-touch and avoid Marcus joining from a plane: 
  1) Move to Tue, 8 June 08:30 PT / 11:30 ET / 17:30 CEST / 00:30 JST (short, but still late for Tokyo)
  2) Move to Tue, 8 June 13:00 PT / 16:00 ET / 22:00 CEST / 05:00 JST (more APAC-friendly if they can do early morning)
  3) Keep Jun 7 slot but have Marcus dial in from a recorded segment and then do a shorter APAC-facing follow-up on Jun 9

I've attached a one-page demo agenda (demo-agenda.pdf). Also adding Karthik to thread to confirm SLAs around recordings/fallbacks.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

On Fri, May 15, 2026 at 09:05 AM Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I've attached a one-page demo agenda (demo-agenda.pdf). Also adding Karthik to thread to confirm SLAs around recordings/fallbacks.
> 
Thanks — sorry to be the blocker here. I'm on an overnight transpacific flight on Jun 7 (touchdown ~11:30 PT on Jun 8); I won't have a reliable window to join live. I've attached my flight itinerary stub (flight-itinerary.pdf).

If APAC absolutely needs live presence, option 2 on Tue 8 June (early JST) works for me if we keep it short. Alternatively, Chloe's idea to record the Marcus-heavy portion and do a focused APAC follow-up is workable.

Short answer: I prefer Jun 8; can make the early JST window if we confirm at least Monday of the week prior so I can rejig travel.

—Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Park <ellie.park@umbratek.io>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@hana-health.jp>, Samir Rao <samir@novatel-health.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 17:09:00 +01:00
Subject: Final: Confirming revised slot — Tue, 8 June (APAC-friendly)

Thanks everyone — appreciate the flexibility.

We ran availability across the three regions and to avoid the UTC/DST mismatch we'll create the invite with the organizer timezone set to Europe/Berlin (CEST) and explicit UTC offset in the title. Proposed confirmed slot:

  - Tue, 8 June 
    07:00 PT / 10:00 ET / 16:00 CEST / 00:00 JST (Wed, 9 June 00:00 JST) — 45 minutes

Notes/why this works: 
  - Keeps a core live overlap for EU + US; APAC can join late-evening (Keiko indicated she can do a midnight start once).
  - Marcus will be on-ground by 11:30 PT on Jun 8 so he's available for the live session.
  - We'll record the Marcus demo segment and share with Keiko & Samir in case they need to view asynchronously.

Action items: 
  - Chloe: please update the calendar invite and put both the CEST start time and explicit UTC offset in the title (e.g., "8 Jun 16:00 CEST / UTC+2 — Umbratek pilot demo").
  - Ellie / Samir / Keiko: confirm OK and I'll send the invite.

Thanks — I'll also add the recording fallback policy to the invite and attach the agenda.

—Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
